title: Slip-On Leather Moccasin Style Shoes with Braided Knot Detail and Segmented Rubber Outsole for Footwear Assortments
highlights:
Slip-on moccasin entry: The low opening removes the need to tie a lace fastening.

Split-leather upper: A pebbled split cow-leather upper covers the foot with a stitched moccasin toe seam.

Segmented rubber contact areas: Separate textured rubber pads follow the forefoot and heel underneath the shoe.
